events.title: Michael Stonebraker leads the Postgres project
events.summary: Michael Stonebraker led the Postgres database project at UC Berkeley in 1986 — extending Ingres with object-relational ideas that became PostgreSQL.
events.about: Stonebraker's Ingres (1970s) and Postgres pioneered relational databases in academia before commercial Oracle and DB2 dominated. PostgreSQL is now the default open-source RDBMS for startups and enterprises.

narrative.whyChosen: Stonebraker's Berkeley projects spawned PostgreSQL and modern open-source SQL.
narrative.whyImportant: Postgres extended relational databases with extensibility and advanced types.
narrative.problemSolved: Relational systems needed richer data models without abandoning SQL.
